Definition
[Primary degenerate-neckpinch ansatz (Ansatz 36.2)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0339, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0340 1. ch36:36.2-ansatz\group Matched Asymptotics

The initial manifold is $S^{n+1}$ with an $\SO (n+1)$-invariant metric, $n\ge 2$. The Ricci curvature is positive near both poles, tangential sectional curvature is positive, scalar curvature is everywhere positive, and there is a bump--neck--bump configuration near the right pole. Curvature becomes unbounded there at a finite first singular time $T$.
